newsitem.title: USA: Clinton sets G-7 summit for June 20-22 in Denver.
newsitem.headline: Clinton sets G-7 summit for June 20-22 in Denver.

text.p: The United States will host the annual summit of the world's seven leading industrialized nations in June in Colorado, the White House announced on Friday.

White House Press Secretary Mike McCurry issued a statement saying world leaders would gather June 20 through June 22 in Denver. The site of the summit had been announced earlier, but the dates had not been determined.
The announcement was made in Texas, where Clinton was making a campaign visit before Tuesday's elections.
